messages:
Maya P: Just pushed deploy v2.3.1 to prod at 09:42 PT. No migrations, feature flags the same. Can folks run the quick post-deploy checklist below and report any red flags?

Checklist (quick):
• sanity endpoint /health (ok)
• core inference path: short + long prompt (latency + correctness)
• embeddings job spot-check (sample)
• metrics: 1m error rate, p95 latency, token cost check
• logs: new WARN/ERROR bursts

Alex Chen: Running /health now. Also kicking off a small canary hitting model-A with long prompt.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: v2.3.1 started rollout @ 2026-03-17T16:42:00Z. Canary group: 1%.

Alex Chen: /health 200, service up. Canary long-prompt latency: 320ms -> that's +40ms vs baseline but still under target. No errors in the sample.

Ben S: Telemetry: p95 for text-gen route jumped from 260ms -> 305ms in the last 3m on canary host pool. Error rate steady at 0.01%. KV cache miss rate slightly higher (~7% -> 12%) which could explain extra latency.

Jordan (prodops): Did this deploy change batching params or kernel selection? I remember a flag flip in the runtime PR. @Alex any config changes?

Alex Chen: The PR adjusted adaptive_batching.threshold from 0.9 -> 0.85 for better throughput. No kernel swap. That explains higher batch formation and occasional queueing. I can revert if we want.

Priya: Quick sanity on embeddings: sample IDs 101-110 returned and similarity checks look fine. Cost per token unchanged. No regressions in output quality on our prompt set.

Ben S: Dashboard note: small uptick in CPU on the routing layer too, correlated with batch changes. Suggest monitoring next 10m before making rollback call.

Maya P: Agreed — let's give it 10m. Action items: Alex to watch batching and be ready to revert threshold; Ben to watch p95 and error rate; Jordan to monitor infra alarms. If p95 exceeds 350ms or error rate >0.1% we rollback. Otherwise we let canary ramp to 10%.

Alex Chen: On it. I also pushed a tiny tweak to reduce max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 1536 as an experiment (can revert).

oncall-bot: alert: latency-canary-p95 exceeded threshold on host pool a at 16:45:12Z (p95=362ms).

Ben S: Seeing the same. p95 spiked to ~370ms on pool A, errors still low. KV miss rate still high. Looks like the max_batch_tokens tweak didn't help; it reduced some tail but not enough.

Alex Chen: Rolling the batching param back to 0.9 now. Command: 
```
rolloutctl set-config runtime.adaptive_batching.threshold=0.9 --scope=canary
```

Alex Chen: Rollback applied to canary pool. Rechecking.

Priya: Embeddings still fine. No new errors in logs since rollback.

Ben S: p95 coming down: 315ms -> 275ms in last 60s. KV miss rate normalizing. No error surge.

Jordan (prodops): Good recovery. Can we hold at 5% for 15m and then ramp? Docs: if stable, canary -> 25% -> 100% with 10m waits.

Maya P: Sounds good. Thanks for quick triage. Leave this thread open for the ramp updates; ping me if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
__notes: This file is a single Slack thread string for post-deploy verification and quick triage. No title field per agents.md rules.
